case.summary: Alert HHF-015 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.71 on in-person transaction 3601725 ($112.75) in region 485. Investigation confirmed that region 485 is an established secondary location for card C00543-K1, representing nine prior transactions with matching product W purchases of near-identical amounts. The cardholder maintains an unvarying spending pattern of in-person product W charges across both baseline and recent windows without channel shifts or customer dispute. Furthermore, the card has no association with suspicious device rings and sits in a community with zero historical fraud. The transaction represents legitimate cardholder activity, and the alert is closed as a false alarm.
